hero.title:
A night
you keep
hero.subTitle:
Join the queue,
pick your seat
hero.subBody: Queue order is shuffled fairly and verifiable. Seats are held briefly, price breakdowns show before you pay, tickets stay safe on your phone.
hero.sceneAlt: A concert stage at dusk with spotlights and a crowd raising their hands

landing.manifesto: TIXGO is the home of concert tickets for people who measure a night in moments, not in queues. Every purchase is designed around one person: you.

queue.title: A fair queue
queue.body: Order is shuffled in a way you can verify yourself, so the fastest fingers beat no one.

price.title: Honest pricing
price.body: The final price is computed by the server and itemised before you pay. No number changes quietly.

ticket.title: A safer ticket
ticket.body: The QR code rotates every 30 seconds, so a screenshot is useless at the gate.

resale.title: Fair resale
resale.body: Tickets can be resold through TixGo at no more than the cap set by the organizer.

flagship.ticketAlt: A black concert ticket with gold lines

specs.title: Pick seats straight from the map
specs.body: Thousands can open a sale in the same second. Stock is decided only in the database, so one seat is never sold twice.
specs.planAlt: Arena plan with the stage on top, a festival floor and curved stands

details.title:
Every detail,
considered
details.lead: The difference is in the parts few people think about.
details.photoAlt: A crowd raising glowing phones in front of the stage

queue.title: A queue you can check
queue.body: Before sales open we lock a fingerprint of the random order. Afterwards you can verify it was never changed.

squad.title: Squad: pay your own share
squad.body: One person holds seats for the group, then each friend pays their share before time runs out.

resale.title: Official resale
resale.body: Resale happens only through TixGo, under a price cap, and the buyer receives a new ticket. The old one stops working.

refund.title: Clear refunds
refund.body: The refund policy is saved when you buy, so the rules don't change midway. If an event is cancelled you are refunded in full.

gate.title: Entry without drama
gate.body: Gate staff can keep scanning when the signal drops, and data syncs automatically once back online.

cities.title: Cities
cities.lead: From campus shows to big festivals
cities.body: TixGo prepares the queue, seats, payment and entry, so the audience can simply show up and enjoy the night.

cta.title:
Pick your concert.
We handle the rest.
cta.body: Join the queue, pick a seat and keep your ticket on your phone. If anything goes wrong, TixGo support replies personally.

footer.tag: Concert ticketing, designed around the audience.

footer.tagline: An unforgettable night, without an unfair queue.

trust.price: Final price shown before you pay

att.renameHint: For typos or a change of person. The QR stays the same.
att.reissueHint: For a leaked or lost QR. The old QR stops working immediately.
att.voidHint: The ticket can no longer be used to enter. This cannot be undone.
att.sureReissue: I understand the old QR stops working immediately and the attendee must use the new one.
att.sureVoid: I understand this ticket will be cancelled and cannot be restored.

ctl.locked: Sales controls are available once the event is published. Until then you can still copy this event.
ctl.pauseB: Buyers cannot order until you resume. Orders already paid are not affected.
ctl.resumeB: Buyers cannot order yet. Resume whenever you are ready.
ctl.rescheduleB: Move the event date. Tickets stay valid and buyers get a chance at a full refund.
ctl.postponeB: The event is postponed and a new date follows. Buyers are notified.
ctl.duplicateB: Create a new draft with the same info, ticket categories, and policy. Dates, sales, and status are not copied.
ctl.cancelB: Every buyer is refunded in full automatically. This cannot be undone.

lead.pause: Write a short reason. It is kept in the event log.
lead.reschedule: Choose the new date and time. Buyers are notified and may ask for a full refund.
lead.postpone: The event is marked postponed. You can reschedule any time once the date is set.
lead.cancel: Think carefully: cancelling triggers mass refunds and cannot be reversed.
lead.duplicate: Choose the new event date. The copy is created as a draft you can edit first.

ctl.impactCancel: {n} sold tickets will be refunded in full, about {total} in total.
ctl.impactPostpone: {n} buyers will be told the event is postponed.
ctl.impactReschedule: {n} buyers will be notified and may ask for a full refund.
ctl.reasonCancelHint: At least 5 characters. Buyers will read this.
ctl.mustFuture: Choose a time in the future.
ctl.typeName: Type the event name to confirm: {title}

promo.lead: Promo codes buyers enter at checkout. The server calculates the discount; you cannot change prices from here.
promo.emptyB: Create a code to attract buyers, like a community discount or a presale.
promo.reportErr: The report could not be loaded.
promo.valueBad: Enter a number above 0 (percent up to 100).
promo.rangeBad: The end time must be after the start time.
promo.tiersHint: Leave empty to apply to all.

org.lead: Check business documents before an organizer may sell paid tickets. Rejecting or asking for info needs a reason the organizer will read.
org.emptyB: There are no organizers with this status yet.
org.reasonHint: At least 10 characters. The organizer reads this note.
org.suspendB: A suspended organizer cannot create or sell events.

users.lead: Find accounts, see their risk signals, then block or change a staff role when needed.
users.emptyB: Change the keyword or clear the filters.
users.reasonBlockHint: At least 3 characters. Recorded in the audit log.
users.roleNote: Staff roles give access to other users' data. Change only when needed.
users.self: This is your own account; actions here are disabled.

pay.lead: Approve, process, and mark organizer payouts. The person who requested a payout cannot approve it themselves.
pay.emptyB: There are no payouts with this status yet.
pay.sameUser: You requested this payout, so you cannot approve it. Ask another finance colleague.
pay.proofHint: Image or PDF, up to 5 MB.
